title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1989-08-17
source: Taper: Danny Thompson; Editing: Joe D'Amico; Akg C460B > Preamp Ck61 Uls > Uher Cr240 Master Tapes > Nak Dragon > Korg Mr-1000 > Adobe Audition CS6 > Traders Little Helper; Recorded Front Row Dead Center Right Behind Soundboard

ai_review.summary: A hot performance captured from a good audience spot, but tape warp and gurgling drip noises detract from the listening experience.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the show as "hot" and notes it was recorded from a favorable position in the venue, suggesting an engaging audience capture. However, they also point out significant tape warping that introduces distracting gurgle‑drip artifacts during key moments, making the recording technically uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review provides a mixed view: positive about the performance but negative about tape warping. The limited data lowers confidence, and the rating reflects a decent show hampered by notable recording flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape appears warped, producing gurgling/dripping noise that distracts during songs; otherwise recorded from a good spot with decent ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewer simply describes the overall show as "hot".
